@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	const cveID = "CVE-2024-5732"
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel(cveID, []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: "nvd@nist.gov",
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.3},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.1, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "other", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.0, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}})
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d contents, want 2", len(contents))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent, len(contents))
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	for source, want := range map[string]struct {
+		score            float64
+		vector, severity string
+	}{
+		"nvd@nist.gov": {8.1, "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", "HIGH"},
+		"other":        {5.0, "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", "MEDIUM"},
+	} {
+		got, ok := bySource[source]
+		if !ok || got.Type != Nvd || got.CveID != cveID || got.Cvss40Score != want.score || got.Cvss40Vector != want.vector || got.Cvss40Severity != want.severity {
+			t.Errorf("source %q: got %+v, want CVSS 4.0 %+v", source, got, want)
+		}
+	}
+	if got := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"].Cvss3Score; got != 7.3 {
+		t.Errorf("CVSS 3 score = %v, want 7.3", got)
+	}
+}
